cited.quote: has appointed Tamil Nadu Salt Corporation as the Nodal Agency

rationale: C1, C2 and C5 concern salt production and salt workers' relief, and C3 even replaces the 'Cottage Industries' heading with 'White Industries'. No extract shows a declaration of salt, anklet, brass, lamp or vessel making as cottage industries.

cited.quote: 7,500 groups, including 1,500 Common Interest Group of Street Vendors will be supported with bank loans of Rs.127.50 crores

rationale: C1 describes loan support to existing TNULM groups, including street-vendor interest groups, as a target in a policy note. It shows no official step creating vendor self-help groups. C3 and C5 concern livelihood parks for SHGs generally, not vendors.

cited.quote: Nutri-kits were provided for mothers of 14,901 malnourished children below 6 months of age
was launched in Ariyalur District on 15.11.2024 by Hon’ble Chief Minister at a cost of Rs.22.20 Crore

rationale: C1 reports the Uttachathai Uruthi Sei scheme giving RUTF and Nutri-kits to malnourished children and infants under 6 months. C2 gives the Phase II launch on 15.11.2024. Phase I is undated in the extracts, so the earliest dated launch is used; the true first date may be earlier.

The promise names no subject for the expert committee. The committees in C1 (hydrocarbon), C2 (scientific officers), C3 (health workforce), C4 (invasive plants) and C5 (education policy) cannot be tied to this commitment, so none is relied on.

None of the extracts mentions a three-phase charge of Rs 50 on electricity bills. C1 and C3 cover electricity tax, C4 EV policy tariffs and C5 free power for powerloom weavers, which are different subjects.
No extract shows any step on restricting FDI in retail. C1 only notes that textile FDI is permitted under the Union policy. The other extracts are unrelated.

cited.quote: Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Detachments are functioning all over the State.

rationale: C1 to C3 only describe the existing Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption and its functions in policy notes. No guideline or order to remove interference in its functioning appears. C4 and C5 are about other subjects.

cited.quote: Subsequently, it has increased to 46 detachments

rationale: C1 to C3 are policy notes describing the Directorate's structure and its detachments, including some for new districts. None cites an administrative order restructuring or strengthening it. C4 and C5 concern school education.

cited.quote: Yarn subsidy, the maximum quantity of yarn to be supplied to a weaver is as below

rationale: C1 describes the existing yarn subsidy, but no extract shows an increase from 10 percent to 15 percent. C4 has a 15% capital subsidy for technical textiles, which is a different scheme. C2, C3 and C5 are other subsidies.

cited.quote: Animal Medical Mobile Ambulance: operating in Public Private Partnership mode

rationale: C1 is a policy note listing existing veterinary institutions and an ambulance service, with no GO or launch date for new veterinary hospitals with an ambulance service. C2 is a pre-2021 audit. C3, C4 and C5 concern human-health ambulances.

cited.quote: be enhanced to 12 months (365 days), with effect from 01.07.2021, with full pay
Enhancement of Maternity Leave from 9 months (270 days) to 12 months

rationale: C3 is G.O. (Ms) No.84 dated 23.08.2021 raising maternity leave for women government servants from 270 to 365 days. C4 amends Fundamental Rule 101(a) accordingly. The scope matches the promise.

cited.quote: the Government has allocated Rs.425 crore over the last four years

rationale: C2, a budget speech, reports allocations and works for temple renovation and consecration, but not a Rs 1000 crore allocation. C1, C3, C4 and C5 are policy notes. None shows a GO sanctioning such an amount.

cited.quote: The Tamil Nadu Folk Artistes Welfare Board was constituted by the Government of Tamil Nadu in the year 2007

rationale: C1 and C3 list folk artistes' welfare benefits (education, marriage, spectacles) with no pension. C2 mentions pensions for temple musicians and poosaris, which are enhancements of existing pensions. C4 and C5 do not concern pensions for artists.

cited.quote: orders were issued according administrative approval for implementation of Coconut Development Board assisted schemes 2022-2023 for Rs.1315.63 lakh
Productivity Improvement through Coconut Based Cropping System (PICCS)

rationale: C3 (G.O. 277 of 17.11.2022) refers to G.O. 224 dated 15.09.2022 approving integrated farming demonstration plots in coconut holdings. C2 adds a later cropping-system scheme. 'Layer farming' is not named, so equivalence is judged from the diversified-farming aim.

cited.quote: Training with demonstration will be conducted for farmers in five state coconut nurseries

rationale: C3 is a budget speech with future-tense training on harvest, solar drying and oil extraction, not layer farming. C1, C2, C4 and C5 are GOs on demonstration plots and organic manure units with no launched training programme on layer farming.

cited.quote: Hence, the Government of Tamil Nadu have decided to reconstruct these houses based on the requests received from the people.

rationale: C1 sets the repair scheme's eligibility, which excludes beyond-repairable houses. C4 starts a separate reconstruction scheme for such houses. It is a new scheme, not an order revising the eligibility of the original housing scheme, and the promised scheme is not identified. C2, C3 and C5 are unrelated housing orders.

cited.quote: Government hereby orders that the fare for mini Buses operating in hill areas shall be fixed at 25% higher
Fare structure which is in force from 29.01.2018 is presented below

rationale: C5, the notified G.O.102 of 26.02.2026, revises mini bus fares, including a 25% higher fare in hill areas. C3 shows the main stage-carriage fare structure unchanged since 2018 and C1 and C2 only report committees. So only mini-bus fares were revised.

No extract is about monthly versus bimonthly electricity billing for households. C1 and C2 concern panchayat grants for electricity dues, C3 e-services through fair price shops, C4 a project's electricity charges and C5 an audit report.

cited.quote: Rs. 1 crore was given from the Chief Minister's Public Relief Fund as solatium to the family of the SSI

rationale: The group covered by the promise is not given. C2 shows one police family receiving Rs 1 crore from a relief fund, while others received Rs 10 to 25 lakh, with no general order. C3 raises sewer-death compensation to Rs 15 lakh and C1 and C5 concern sterilization compensation.

cited.quote: promoted through SHGs to provide affordable healthy food to anaemic women and children

rationale: C1 mentions nutri-enterprises for anaemic women and underweight children, and C2 to C4 describe school meals. None shows a food basket scheme for malnourished infants. C5 is a minimum-wage notification.
